newsitem.title: EGYPT: Sudan's Mahdi in Cairo on Friday, opposition says.
newsitem.headline: Sudan's Mahdi in Cairo on Friday, opposition says.

text.p: Ousted Sudanese prime minister Sadeq al-Mahdi is due in Cairo on Friday for talks with Egyptian officials and members of the Sudanese opposition in exile, an official in the opposition said on Thursday.
Farouq Abu Eissa, spokesman for the opposition umbrella group the National Democratic Alliance, told Reuters that Mahdi would arrive late on Friday for an "extended visit".
The opposition alliance has started attacking Sudan from its base in Eritrea.
Sudanese President Omar Hassan al-Bashir overthrew Mahdi's democratically elected government in a bloodless coup in 1989.
Two weeks ago, Mahdi fled Khartoum for Eritrea, which hosts and encourages the Sudanese opposition.
"Mr. Mahdi will meet with members of the NDA and other Egyptian officials as part of the NDA's drive to remove the regime in Sudan and establish, peace, democracy and the rule of law," Eissa said.
